definitions.explanation: An adult female human. A formal and neutral term for referring to women.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}{専用|せんよう}{車両|しゃりょう}に{乗|の}りました。
examples.english: I rode in the women-only car.
examples.notes: Train cars for women during rush hour

examples.japanese: この{会社|かいしゃ}は{女性|じょせい}{社員|しゃいん}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: This company has many female employees.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}の{方|かた}はこちらへどうぞ。
{日本|にほん}では、{働|はたら}く{女性|じょせい}の{数|かず}が{年々|ねんねん}{増|ふ}えています。
examples.english: In Japan, the number of working women is increasing year by year.

examples.japanese: この{雑誌|ざっし}は{二十代|にじゅうだい}の{女性|じょせい}を{対象|たいしょう}にしています。
examples.english: This magazine is aimed at women in their twenties.

notes:
{女性|じょせい} is a formal, neutral term for women.

COMPARISON OF TERMS:
- {女性|じょせい}: woman (formal, neutral)
- {女|おんな}: woman/female (can be rude in some contexts)
- {女|おんな}の{人|ひと}: woman (polite, everyday)
- {女|おんな}の{子|こ}: girl
- {女|め}: female (literary, compounds)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女性|じょせい}{社員|しゃいん}: female employee
- {女性|じょせい}{専用|せんよう}: women-only
- {女性|じょせい}{向|む}け: for women
- {若|わか}い{女性|じょせい}: young woman

OPPOSITE:
- {男性|だんせい}: man, male
